prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference images 1 and 2 are STYLE references only: match their flat posterized colour fills in a few tonal steps, thin dark ink outlines, small ink hatch marks and muted naturalistic palette; do not copy their subject, their forest or their composition.
Subject: a long way round along a tropical shore, seen from the near end. In the foreground, pale cream sand at the edge of a clear, still turquoise lagoon. Further along, the pale sand turns to smooth wet brown mud, with a few low dark rocks along the waterline. Ahead, where the shore curves, a low dark wood of trees standing on tall arching stilt roots over the brown mud and water, their roots clearly visible. The way is simply the open shore between the water and the land, smooth and untouched, with no marks on the sand or the mud. Soft daylight, pale sky. No people, no animals, no boats.
Style: vanilla survival card game location art: flat posterized colour fills, thin dark ink outlines, small ink hatch marks, muted naturalistic palette, a full-frame portrait scene (2:3). The painted scene reaches every edge of the frame. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: footprints, tracks, prints in the ground, sand, mud or snow, drag marks, a worn trail line, people, animals, birds, boats, watercolour, soft gradients, glossy digital painting, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, anime, flat vector art, pixel art, neon colours, lens flare, blurry, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, plain white background, vignette, white border.
